Bid Summary.value: The Offeror must comply with insurance, bid bond, and liability requirements set by Dallas ISD as noted in the proposal-specific questions. Responses may be submitted online via the iSupplier portal after registering early, or manually as a sealed envelope delivered to the Procurement Services Department by the stated deadline. Manual submissions require one original hard copy, and no fax or email submissions are accepted, with only one format needed. Vendors must provide company information including firm name, Federal Tax ID number, address, telephone number, and counts of both non-clerical and clerical personnel. Additionally, pertinent product literature or documentation and any required credit application forms must be included at the time of offer submission.
